session 7f3a · agent: coding-agent · branch fix/checkout
    Claude Code/Codex CLI/Cursor/Gemini CLI/Copilot agent/OpenCode/Any MCP harness/

    Evidence, not transcripts.

    01 / Claim check

    Every “done” is tested.

    When an agent ends a turn claiming success, Tracewell reruns the relevant tests and blocks the claim if they fail.

    ✕ claim: "checkout bug fixed" 2 tests failing
    02 / Timeline

    Rewind any run.

    Scrub through commands, file diffs and tool calls on one timeline.

    03 / Local

    Nothing leaves your machine.

    Sessions are stored in your repo's .tracewell/ folder.

    04 / CI

    Gate merges.

    Fail the pipeline when a PR contains unverified agent claims.

    05 / Overhead

    0ms

    Target added latency per tool call in the open-source recorder.

    Three steps. No new habits.

    01

    Record

    A hook in your agent's settings streams each tool call to a local log. Zero code changes.

    02

    Verify

    When the agent claims success, Tracewell runs your test command and compares the result.

    03

    Review

    Open tracewell view to replay the run, or attach the evidence bundle to the pull request.
